description: This file provides utility functions for interacting with Azure CLI (az), including executing commands, error handling, checking installation, retrieving account info, listing subscriptions, obtaining access tokens, and performing device code login.

methods.name: summarizeAzErrorMessage
methods.description: Normalizes and summarizes error messages from Azure CLI commands.

methods.name: buildAzCommandError
methods.description: Creates a detailed Error object based on stderr and stdout from az command execution.

methods.name: execAz
methods.description: Synchronously executes an az CLI command with given arguments.

methods.name: execAzAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes an az CLI command with given arguments.

methods.name: isAzCliInstalled
methods.description: Checks if Azure CLI is installed by attempting to run 'az version'.

methods.name: getLoggedInAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the current Azure account information if logged in.

methods.name: buildAccessTokenArgs
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for obtaining an access token, based on optional subscription or tenant IDs.

methods.name: getAccessTokenResult
methods.description: Retrieves an access token synchronously for specified subscription or tenant.

methods.name: getAccessTokenResultAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an access token asynchronously for specified subscription or tenant.

methods.name: azLoginDeviceCode
methods.description: Initiates device code login flow with Azure CLI.

methods.name: azLoginDeviceCodeWithOptions
methods.description: Initiates device code login with additional options such as tenant ID and subscription allowance.
